names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιος Γρηγόριος επίσκοπος Ναζιανζού πατέρας του αγίου Γρηγορίου θεολόγου», with the rank word and the office left off.

floruit.note: The two fixed years in his own life.md and the length that follows them: «He was baptised in 325, was raised to the bishopric of Nazianzus in 328, and was bishop there for forty-five years.» Forty-five years from 328 ends in 373; the floruit runs from the baptism to there rather than asserting a year of death the page does not print.
